# About this thesis

This is the landing page for Damian Betebenner's dissertation, "IRTc: Copula-Based Item Response Theory",
at dataimago (Independent research — educational measurement & psychometrics (dataimago)).

The thesis is rendered via Quarto + XeLaTeX to a PDF whenever you push changes
to `ui/www/` or `R/`; a stable copy is committed to `docs/thesis.pdf` by the
`build-thesis.yml` workflow.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
**Read it:** [the thesis PDF](thesis.pdf) (latest CI build) · [the R package
reference](r-package.qmd) (functions, rendered from the roxygen docs).
:::
